loss_spec.interpretation: Minimize 3.25*A-Q+0.05*R. Q sums arithmetic means of raw reviewer overall_score for accepted review-history decisions; unreviewed acceptance contributes zero Q but incurs acceptance cost. R counts all actual reviews, accepted or rejected. Institution-written final_score is NOT used. Coefficients encode an explicit illustrative publication/review cost preference, not an empirically calibrated science-quality law. Reject-all and all-accept are legal; no hidden veto.

artifact.source:
def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    office = 'evidence-office-v12'
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get(office)
    authors = sorted([a for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author'] and a['is_active']], key=lambda a: a['id'])
    papers = sorted([p for p in world['papers']['papers'] if p['year'] < year], key=lambda p: (p['year'], p['id']))
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, principal=office):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-domain-command-v1', 'command_id': str(year) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id': principal, 'action': action, 'payload': payload}})
    if old is None:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id': office, 'type': 'evidence-office', 'roles': ['evidence-curator'],
            'state': {'cycles': 0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = old['revision'] if old else 0
    emit('advance', 'actor.update', {'id': office, 'expected_revision': revision, 'roles': ['evidence-curator'],
        'state': {'cycles': revision + 1, 'last_year': year, 'prior_papers': len(papers)}})
    for index, author in enumerate(authors):
        own = [p for p in papers if author['id'] in (p['author_id'] if isinstance(p['author_id'], list) else [p['author_id']])]
        recent = own[-2:]
        related = [p for p in papers if p not in own and set(p.get('topics', [])) & set(author.get('expertise', []))][-2:]
        evidence = [{'paper_id': p['id'], 'title': p['title'], 'abstract': p['abstract'][:500],
            'status': p['status'], 'review_history': p.get('review_history', [])} for p in recent + related]
        brief = {'protocol': 'EVIDENCE_OFFICE_V12', 'year': year, 'recipient': author['id'],
            'expertise': author.get('expertise', []), 'observed_evidence': evidence,
            'research_brief': 'Choose a coherent, feasible research contribution within your expertise. '
                'Use the actual evidence above to identify one unresolved question, a concrete method and an informative comparison. '
                'For prior rejected work, address the recorded criticism before repeating the same claim. '
                'For collaboration, seek complementary expertise and agree on a specific testable contribution. '
                'Ground literature selection in the available real-paper corpus and state limitations honestly. '
                'This brief supplies information; you retain scientific choices and native production constraints.'}
        record = 'evidence-brief-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
        emit('record-' + str(index), 'artifact.create', {'id': record, 'type': 'evidence-brief',
            'owner_actor': office, 'content': brief, 'actor_ids': [office, author['id']], 'artifact_ids': [],
            'native_paper_ids': [p['id'] for p in recent + related]})
        emit('deliver-' + str(index), 'native.context', {'actor_ids': [author['id']],
            'content': brief, 'artifact_ids': [record]})
    return {'outputs': {'commands': commands}, 'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1,
        'last_year': year, 'delivered': len(authors)}}

artifact.label: External Codex exact marginal reviewed utility
artifact.source:
def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    decisions = []
    summaries = []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            mean = sum(review['overall_score'] for review in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            # A reviewed acceptance changes the fixed loss by 3.25 - raw mean.
            # Review expense is already incurred and is never subtracted twice.
            accept = bool(reviews) and mean > 3.25
            decisions.append({'payload': {'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id'],
                'decision': 'accept' if accept else 'reject', 'final_score': mean}})
            summaries.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'raw_review_mean': mean, 'review_count': len(reviews),
                'acceptance_loss_increment': 3.25 - mean, 'accepted': accept})
    return {'outputs': {'decisions': decisions or [{'payload': {'empty_cycle': True}}],
        'next': [{'payload': {'year': context['period']}}], 'world': [{'payload': world}]},
        'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_decisions': summaries}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

artifact.source:
def step(context):
    plan = context['inputs']['plans'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    if plan['year'] != year:
        raise ValueError('milestone clinic requires current native plans')
    # A declared scientific programme closes every second native year.
    # Scope projects, never create papers or replace native production laws.
    cycle_end = year if year % 2 == 0 else year + 1
    amendments = []
    changes = []
    for original in plan['assignments']:
        start = original['project_start_year']
        if original['project_end_year'] == cycle_end:
            continue
        assignment = dict(original)
        direction = dict(original['direction'])
        direction['years'] = cycle_end - start + 1
        assignment['direction'] = direction
        assignment['project_end_year'] = cycle_end
        assignment['detailed_focus'] = original['detailed_focus'] + (
            ' MILESTONE_CLINIC_V12: Scope this programme to one coherent, testable milestone by the end of year '
            + str(cycle_end) + '. Preserve the chosen scientific topic and identify the essential comparison and limitations. '
            'Use the native available literature and production process; do not claim unsupported results.')
        assignment['reason'] = original['reason'] + ' Institutional two-year programme scoping.'
        amendments.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-research-amendment-v1', 'target_year': year,
            'assignment': assignment, 'submit': cycle_end == year}})
        changes.append({'actor_id': original['actor_id'], 'original_end': original['project_end_year'],
            'milestone_end': cycle_end, 'duration': direction['years']})
    return {'outputs': {'amendments': amendments}, 'state': {
        'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_year': year, 'last_changes': changes,
        'total_amendments': context['state'].get('total_amendments', 0) + len(amendments)}}

artifact.label: External Codex exact marginal reviewed utility
artifact.source:
def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    decisions = []
    summaries = []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            mean = sum(review['overall_score'] for review in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            # A reviewed acceptance changes the fixed loss by 3.25 - raw mean.
            # Review expense is already incurred and is never subtracted twice.
            accept = bool(reviews) and mean > 3.25
            decisions.append({'payload': {'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id'],
                'decision': 'accept' if accept else 'reject', 'final_score': mean}})
            summaries.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'raw_review_mean': mean, 'review_count': len(reviews),
                'acceptance_loss_increment': 3.25 - mean, 'accepted': accept})
    return {'outputs': {'decisions': decisions or [{'payload': {'empty_cycle': True}}],
        'next': [{'payload': {'year': context['period']}}], 'world': [{'payload': world}]},
        'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_decisions': summaries}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    decisions = []
    summaries = []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            mean = sum(review['overall_score'] for review in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            # A reviewed acceptance changes the fixed loss by 3.25 - raw mean.
            # Review expense is already incurred and is never subtracted twice.
            accept = bool(reviews) and mean > 3.25
            decisions.append({'payload': {'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id'],
                'decision': 'accept' if accept else 'reject', 'final_score': mean}})
            summaries.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'raw_review_mean': mean, 'review_count': len(reviews),
                'acceptance_loss_increment': 3.25 - mean, 'accepted': accept})
    return {'outputs': {'decisions': decisions or [{'payload': {'empty_cycle': True}}],
        'next': [{'payload': {'year': context['period']}}], 'world': [{'payload': world}]},
        'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_decisions': summaries}}

def step(context):

def step(context):
    plan = context['inputs']['plans'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    if plan['year'] != year:
        raise ValueError('milestone clinic requires current native plans')
    # A declared scientific programme closes every second native year.
    # Scope projects, never create papers or replace native production laws.
    cycle_end = year if year % 2 == 0 else year + 1
    amendments = []
    changes = []
    for original in plan['assignments']:
        start = original['project_start_year']
        if original['project_end_year'] == cycle_end:
            continue
        assignment = dict(original)
        direction = dict(original['direction'])
        direction['years'] = cycle_end - start + 1
        assignment['direction'] = direction
        assignment['project_end_year'] = cycle_end
        assignment['detailed_focus'] = original['detailed_focus'] + (
            ' MILESTONE_CLINIC_V12: Scope this programme to one coherent, testable milestone by the end of year '
            + str(cycle_end) + '. Preserve the chosen scientific topic and identify the essential comparison and limitations. '
            'Use the native available literature and production process; do not claim unsupported results.')
        assignment['reason'] = original['reason'] + ' Institutional two-year programme scoping.'
        amendments.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-research-amendment-v1', 'target_year': year,
            'assignment': assignment, 'submit': cycle_end == year}})
        changes.append({'actor_id': original['actor_id'], 'original_end': original['project_end_year'],
            'milestone_end': cycle_end, 'duration': direction['years']})
    return {'outputs': {'amendments': amendments}, 'state': {
        'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_year': year, 'last_changes': changes,

def step(context):
    plan = context['inputs']['plans'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    if plan['year'] != year:
        raise ValueError('milestone clinic requires current native plans')
    # A declared scientific programme closes every second native year.
    # Scope projects, never create papers or replace native production laws.
    cycle_end = year if year % 2 == 0 else year + 1
    amendments = []
    changes = []
    for original in plan['assignments']:
        start = original['project_start_year']
        if original['project_end_year'] == cycle_end:
            continue
        assignment = dict(original)
        direction = dict(original['direction'])
        direction['years'] = cycle_end - start + 1
        assignment['direction'] = direction
        assignment['project_end_year'] = cycle_end
        assignment['detailed_focus'] = original['detailed_focus'] + (
            ' MILESTONE_CLINIC_V12: Scope this programme to one coherent, testable milestone by the end of year '
            + str(cycle_end) + '. Preserve the chosen scientific topic and identify the essential comparison and limitations. '
            'Use the native available literature and production process; do not claim unsupported results.')
        assignment['reason'] = original['reason'] + ' Institutional two-year programme scoping.'
        amendments.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-research-amendment-v1', 'target_year': year,
            'assignment': assignment, 'submit': cycle_end == year}})
        changes.append({'actor_id': original['actor_id'], 'original_end': original['project_end_year'],
            'milestone_end': cycle_end, 'duration': direction['years']})
    return {'outputs': {'amendments': amendments}, 'state': {
        'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1, 'last_year': year, 'last_changes': changes,
        'total_amendments': context['state'].get('total_amendments', 0) + len(amendments)}}

    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):

            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})

        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})

            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}
